text:
sam: Ran a 6h replay comparing three queue configs: baseline, delayed-max-20ms, and adaptive-batch. Uploaded CSV + plots: https://internal/bench/199876. Quick summary: adaptive cuts token cost ~12% but p95 latency went up on small requests. Thoughts?

anya: Thanks — can you paste the p95 numbers?

sam: Sure, here's the quick table from the run:
```
config, p50_ms, p95_ms, avg_batch, kv_hit
baseline, 9.2, 24.8, 28.1, 0.72
delayed-max-20ms, 10.1, 26.0, 33.7, 0.70
adaptive-batch, 11.5, 32.4, 45.3, 0.58
```

raj: Hmm — adaptive increases avg batch a lot (nice) but p95 jump is concerning. Did KV cache hit-rate drop? that could explain extra token work.

sam: Yep, kv hit dropped as shown above. Short kv trace snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:22:11Z] tenant=A op=serve seq=124 kv_hit=false
[2026-03-15T09:22:11Z] tenant=B op=serve seq=125 kv_hit=true
[2026-03-15T09:22:11Z] tenant=C op=serve seq=126 kv_hit=false
```

perf-bot: perf-alert: kernel-swap detected during adaptive-batch segment — median kernel selection changed to int8-fastpath for 18% of requests; measured +3.2% median latency compared to pinned kernel.

leah: Could be a combo: interleaving from bigger batches evicts KV entries more frequently, and kernel-swap causes intermittent slower paths. Two knobs to try: reduce max_delay and pin kernel selection during run.

tom: Agreed. We should also try raising batch cap slightly but lowering max_delay to avoid huge interleaving windows. Suggested config to run next:
```
./replay-run --trace-kv --pin-kernel=int8 --max-delay-ms=12 --batch-cap=48 --tag=199876-fix1
```

anya: Also curious about multi-tenant fairness — which tenants saw the worst tail?

sam: Tenant A and Tenant C had spikes in p95. Quick per-tenant tail excerpt:
```
tenant,A,p95_ms,48.1
tenant,B,p95_ms,22.7
tenant,C,p95_ms,51.9
```

raj: If adaptive batching increases inter-tenant mixing, hot tenants may evict other tenants' KV state. That explains tenant C regressions. We should capture per-tenant KV eviction counts next run.

sam: Will add eviction counts and per-tenant batch histograms. Plan: run pinned-kernel + max_delay=12 + collect kv evictions + 1h canary on prod-sim.

leah: :thumbsup: sounds good. If that looks stable we can try incremental rollout (10% -> 50%).

tom: No objections. Also add a run that pins to float16 kernel to see if int8-specific path hurts.

sam: Cool — I'll kick off three runs (pin=int8, pin=float16, baseline) and post results. Can we sync briefly about this today at 14:00?

leah: works for me.

anya: I'll join.

tom: I'll be there too.

sam: Thanks — posting logs/links once jobs finish. If anyone wants raw traces, add me and I'll share the S3 bucket link.

perf-bot: benchmark-run queued: id=bench-199876-fix1, expected ~70m per config.
